Coffee

What is in the cup

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Roasted on site

The beans are roasted in the shop itself, on the roaster by the window. One guest mentions different blends.

Espresso and flat white

Espresso drinks from the bar, from flat white to an iced oat latte and a matcha latte.

Filter and cold brew

Pour over, iced pour over and cold brew. 5 reviews mention the cold brew.

Cakes and bars

Cakes, cheesecake, pies and energy bars to go with the coffee. 7 reviews mention the cakes.

The shop and the cups

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Light and space

Floor to ceiling windows, minimal decor and good music. One guest calls the room spacious and airy.

Good for working

Long tables and single tables. Guests write that they work or study here with a laptop.

Dogs welcome

The café is pet friendly, 3 reviews mention it. There is also seating outside by the entrance.

On Pindarou

At Pindarou 29D in Nicosia. Open Monday to Friday from 7:30, Saturday until 15:00.

What guests say

Three of 282 Google reviews, 221 of them with five stars.
